title: Request Account Request
description: Ask the seller for an advertiser account: find an existing one or create one, possibly after human review on either side. Experimental in 3.3 (#8280): sellers implementing this task MUST list account.requests in experimental_features. Retries are safe through idempotency_key; deduplicating separate requests for the same advertiser is seller discretion, with non-normative guidance in the task docs. Send either account_id, or brand and operator; sellers enforce this at runtime so the MCP input schema stays a plain root object, and reject a request carrying both, or neither, with INVALID_REQUEST.
x-tool-summary: Request an advertiser account: the seller matches an existing account or creates one, possibly after human review.

idempotency_key.description: Client-generated key that makes retries of this call safe, with the standard replay semantics. A replayed key returns the original request; a new key is a new request. Use a fresh UUID v4 for each logical call.

account_id.description: Request an account the seller already identified: one of the candidates from an ambiguous request, or, on a platform that owns its account namespace, an account the caller's credential does not reach yet. For an account_id the caller cannot reach, the seller MUST answer the same way whether or not the account exists: either always rejected with ACCOUNT_NOT_FOUND, or, for sellers that support access requests, always in_review with waiting_on: buyer and kind: grant. Mutually exclusive with brand and operator.

brand.description: Advertiser identity. Required unless account_id is sent. Sellers matching on brand use domain and brand_id; countries is an attribute.

operator.description: Domain of the entity operating on the brand's behalf. When the brand operates directly, the brand's domain. The seller verifies it against the brand's authorized_operators and, where grants are supported, the operator's grant to the calling agent. Required unless account_id is sent.

operator_unit.description: Optional operator-owned business unit or seat. An account attribute; name is display metadata.

currency.description: Immutable ISO 4217 currency for a currency-bound advertiser object, as in sync_accounts. An account attribute.

timezone.description: Buyer-selected immutable timezone when the seller declares account_fixed, buyer_selected timezones, as in sync_accounts. An account attribute.

sandbox.description: Request a sandbox account. An account attribute: a sandbox request does not match a production account.

billing.description: Requested invoiced party. A requested term, not account identity. The seller accepts it exactly or rejects the request; billing is never silently remapped.

billing_entity.description: Requested business entity for the invoiced party. A requested term, not account identity. Bank details are write-only.

payment_terms.description: Requested payment terms. A requested term, not account identity. The seller accepts them or rejects the request.
